title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 16 · Biography of Du Ji

text.en: A note records that Du Ji was a descendant of the Han Imperial Censor Du Yannian, whose family later settled at Duling.
text.zht: 有註記載杜畿為漢御史大夫杜延年之後，其家後來世居杜陵。
text.zhs: 有注记载杜畿为汉御史大夫杜延年之后，其家后来世居杜陵。

text.en: Du Yannian's father Du Zhou moved from Nanyang to Maoling.
text.zht: 杜延年之父杜周自南陽遷居茂陵。
text.zhs: 杜延年之父杜周自南阳迁居茂陵。

text.en: After hearing Du Ji converse through the night with his neighbour Geng Ji, Xun Yu was much impressed, felt he understood him as though they had long been acquainted, and promptly recommended him to the court.
text.zht: 荀彧聽聞杜畿與鄰居耿紀徹夜長談，深為讚賞，與之相見如舊識，隨即向朝廷舉薦了他。
text.zhs: 荀彧听闻杜畿与邻居耿纪彻夜长谈，深为赞赏，与之相见如旧识，随即向朝廷举荐了他。

text.en: When Cao Cao asked Xun Yu to recommend a Xiao He or Kou Xun to hold the strategic commandery of Hedong, Xun Yu answered, "Du Ji is the man," commending him as brave enough to face great peril and resourceful enough to adapt to change.
text.zht: 曹操請荀彧舉薦能鎮守河東的蕭何、寇恂之才，荀彧答道：「杜畿其人也。」稱他勇於臨危而善於應變。
text.zhs: 曹操请荀彧举荐能镇守河东的萧何、寇恂之才，荀彧答道：「杜畿其人也。」称他勇于临危而善于应变。

text.en: On reaching Xu, Du Ji met the Palace Attendant Geng Ji and conversed with him throughout the night.
text.zht: 杜畿抵達許都後拜訪侍中耿紀，與之徹夜長談。
text.zhs: 杜畿抵达许都后拜访侍中耿纪，与之彻夜长谈。

text.en: Having overheard Du Ji's conversation next door, Xun Yu sent word to his neighbour Geng Ji at dawn, reproaching him for knowing such a talent yet failing to recommend him.
text.zht: 荀彧隔壁聽聞杜畿談論，天明遣人責備鄰居耿紀知有奇才而不舉薦。
text.zhs: 荀彧隔壁听闻杜畿谈论，天明遣人责备邻居耿纪知有奇才而不举荐。

text.en: Du Ji's old acquaintance Zhang Shi, Intendant of Jingzhao, made him his Merit Section Administrator, but disliked his free and easy temperament and called him derelict and unfit for the post; Du Ji retorted that he might not be fit to be Merit Section Administrator but was fit to be Grand Administrator of Hedong.
text.zht: 舊識張時任京兆尹，任命杜畿為功曹，卻嫌他放逸不理事，說他不宜任功曹；杜畿私下回應說自己不宜為功曹，卻宜為河東太守。
text.zhs: 旧识张时任京兆尹，任命杜畿为功曹，却嫌他放逸不理事，说他不宜任功曹；杜畿私下回应说自己不宜为功曹，却宜为河东太守。

text.en: When Du Ji later went to welcome the Colonel of the Capital and met Zhang Shi at Huayin, Zhang Shi sighed, "Yesterday a Merit Section Administrator, today a commandery's governor!"
text.zht: 杜畿後來迎接司隸校尉，在華陰遇見張時，張時感嘆：「昨日功曹，今為郡將！」
text.zhs: 杜畿后来迎接司隶校尉，在华阴遇见张时，张时感叹：「昨日功曹，今为郡将！」

text.en: Recommended by Xun Yu, Du Ji was appointed Rectifier under the Excellency of Works, then Colonel Protecting the Qiang and Grand Administrator of Xiping.
text.zht: 經荀彧舉薦，杜畿被曹操任命為司空司直，後遷護羌校尉，兼任西平太守。
text.zhs: 经荀彧举荐，杜畿被曹操任命为司空司直，后迁护羌校尉，兼任西平太守。

title.en: Rectifier under the Excellency of Works

text.en: When Gao Gan rebelled and Hedong was in danger, Cao Cao recalled Du Ji and appointed him Grand Administrator of Hedong.
text.zht: 高幹叛亂、河東告急之際，曹操召回杜畿，任命他為河東太守。
text.zhs: 高幹叛乱、河东告急之际，曹操召回杜畿，任命他为河东太守。

text.en: Cao Cao praised Du Ji as a man of whom Confucius might have said "I can find no fault in him", raised his rank to Fully 2000 Shi, and circulated a proclamation urging all to look up to Du Ji's conduct.
text.zht: 曹操稱杜畿為孔子所謂「吾無間然」之人，將他的秩祿提升為中二千石，並頒令諸州郡以杜畿為榜樣。
text.zhs: 曹操称杜畿为孔子所谓「吾无间然」之人，将他的秩禄提升为中二千石，并颁令诸州郡以杜畿为榜样。

text.en: When the kingdom of Wei was established Du Ji was appointed to the Imperial Secretariat, but Cao Cao asked him to remain and secure Hedong, which he governed for sixteen years with the finest record in the realm.
text.zht: 魏國建立後杜畿被任命為尚書，曹操卻請他留鎮河東，前後十六年，政績為天下最。
text.zhs: 魏国建立后杜畿被任命为尚书，曹操却请他留镇河东，前后十六年，政绩为天下最。

text.en: Wei Gu had known Du Ji since youth and often treated him with contempt, cursing him when Du Ji jokingly announced he was now administrator of Hedong.
text.zht: 衞固自少與杜畿相熟，常輕視他，杜畿戲稱自己將為河東太守時，衞固撩衣咒罵。
text.zhs: 卫固自少与杜畿相熟，常轻视他，杜畿戏称自己将为河东太守时，卫固撩衣咒骂。

text.en: Wei Gu joined Gao Gan and Zhang Sheng in attacking Du Ji but could not defeat him, and was executed once the main army arrived.
text.zht: 衞固聯合高幹、張晟進攻杜畿而不能取勝，大軍到達後被誅殺。
text.zhs: 卫固联合高干、张晟进攻杜畿而不能取胜，大军到达后被诛杀。

text.en: Du Ji appointed Wei Gu Commander and Assistant of the commandery, but though Wei Gu nominally served him he paid him little heed, secretly summoned troops, and joined the rebellion.
text.zht: 杜畿任命衞固為都督、行郡丞事，衞固名義上服從，實則不放在眼裡，暗中召兵並加入叛亂。
text.zhs: 杜畿任命卫固为都督、行郡丞事，卫固名义上服从，实则不放在眼里，暗中召兵并加入叛乱。

text.en: Fan Xian wished to kill Du Ji to establish his authority and beheaded more than thirty officials at the gate in front of him, while Du Ji remained perfectly composed; he later urged that Du Ji be killed as a future menace.
text.zht: 范先欲殺杜畿以立威，當著他的面在門前斬殺三十餘名官吏，杜畿神色自若；范先後來仍主張除掉杜畿以絕後患。
text.zhs: 范先欲杀杜畿以立威，当着他的面在门前斩杀三十余名官吏，杜畿神色自若；范先后来仍主张除掉杜畿以绝后患。

text.en: Du Ji placed all the military officers, officials and troops under Fan Xian's command, but Fan Xian only nominally served him and plotted against him with Wei Gu.
text.zht: 杜畿將全郡將吏兵馬交由范先統領，范先名義上服從，實則與衞固合謀對抗他。
text.zhs: 杜畿将全郡将吏兵马交由范先统领，范先名义上服从，实则与卫固合谋对抗他。

text.en: Wei Gu and Fan Xian publicly petitioned for Hedong's Grand Administrator to stay, but were secretly plotting with Gao Gan; Wei Gu later joined Gao Gan in attacking Du Ji.
text.zht: 衞固、范先表面上請求留任河東太守，暗中卻與高幹勾結；衞固後來與高幹一同進攻杜畿。
text.zhs: 卫固、范先表面上请求留任河东太守，暗中却与高幹勾结；卫固后来与高幹一同进攻杜畿。

text.en: Wei Gu and Fan Xian publicly petitioned for Hedong's Grand Administrator to stay, but were secretly plotting with Gao Gan.
text.zht: 衞固、范先表面上請求留任河東太守，暗中卻與高幹勾結。
text.zhs: 卫固、范先表面上请求留任河东太守，暗中却与高幹勾结。

text.en: Gao Gan and Zhang Sheng together, with Wei Gu, attacked Du Ji at Zhangbi and were defeated when the main army arrived.
text.zht: 高幹與張晟聯合衞固攻打杜畿，大軍到達後被擊敗。
text.zhs: 高幹与张晟联合卫固攻打杜畿，大军到达后被击败。

text.en: Wei Gu and others joined Gao Gan and Zhang Sheng in attacking Du Ji and raiding the counties.
text.zht: 衞固等人聯合高幹、張晟進攻杜畿並劫掠諸縣。
text.zhs: 卫固等人联合高幹、张晟进攻杜畿并劫掠诸县。

text.en: Zhang Sheng was raiding the region between Mount Yao and Mianchi and had established contact with Liu Biao to the south.
text.zht: 張晟劫掠崤山、澠池一帶，並與南方的劉表建立了聯繫。
text.zhs: 张晟劫掠崤山、渑池一带，并与南方的刘表建立了联系。

text.en: A note records that the Erudite Yue Xiang owed his advancement to Du Ji, and that Hedong's many scholars were also Du Ji's doing.
text.zht: 有註記載博士樂詳的仕進得益於杜畿，河東多有學者亦是杜畿之功。
text.zhs: 有注记载博士乐详的仕进得益于杜畿，河东多有学者亦是杜畿之功。

text.en: Liu Xun, a favourite of Cao Cao whose influence awed the court, asked Du Ji for some large jujubes, but Du Ji put him off; after Liu Xun's execution Cao Cao found the letter and remarked that Du Ji did not curry favour with the stove.
text.zht: 曹操寵臣劉勳權勢威震朝廷，曾向杜畿索要大棗，杜畿推託不與；劉勳被誅後曹操發現此信，感嘆杜畿真可謂「不媚灶」之人。
text.zhs: 曹操宠臣刘勋权势威震朝廷，曾向杜畿索要大枣，杜畿推托不与；刘勋被诛后曹操发现此信，感叹杜畿真可谓「不媚灶」之人。

text.en: Liu Xun, General Who Subdues the Enemies, was a favourite of Cao Cao whose influence awed the court, until his execution.
text.zht: 徵虜將軍劉勳為曹操寵臣，威勢震懾朝廷，後被誅殺。
text.zhs: 征虏将军刘勋为曹操宠臣，威势震慑朝廷，后被诛杀。

text.en: When Cao Pi became king he granted Du Ji the title Marquis Within the Pass and summoned him to the Imperial Secretariat; on ascending the throne he made him Neighbourhood Marquis of Fengle and acting Colonel of the Capital, and during the Wu campaign Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat in charge of the capital. When Du Ji drowned testing a tower ship, the emperor wept.
text.zht: 曹丕即王位後賜杜畿關內侯並徵入尚書檯；稱帝后進封杜畿為豐樂亭侯，行司隸校尉事；伐吳時任尚書僕射，留守都城。杜畿試乘樓船溺亡，曹丕為之流涕。
text.zhs: 曹丕即王位后赐杜畿关内侯并征入尚书台；称帝后进封杜畿为丰乐亭侯，行司隶校尉事；伐吴时任尚书仆射，留守都城。杜畿试乘楼船溺亡，曹丕为之流涕。

title.en: Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat

text.en: Cao Pi's edict mourned Du Ji's loyalty, likening his death on the water to sage officials of old; he was posthumously appointed Minister Coachman with the title Marquis Dai.
text.zht: 曹丕下詔哀悼杜畿之忠，以古代賢臣歿於水事相比；追贈太僕，諡戴侯。
text.zhs: 曹丕下诏哀悼杜畿之忠，以古代贤臣殁于水事相比；追赠太仆，谥戴侯。

text.en: Zhao Yan succeeded Du Ji in Hedong and sent many widows to be registered where Du Ji had sent few; Du Ji told Cao Pi that those he registered were wives of dead men while Zhao Yan's were wives of living men.
text.zht: 趙儼接任河東太守後，登記送走的寡婦遠多於杜畿；杜畿對曹丕說自己送的都是亡夫之妻，趙儼送的卻是活人之妻。
text.zhs: 赵俨接任河东太守后，登记送走的寡妇远多于杜畿；杜畿对曹丕说自己送的都是亡夫之妻，赵俨送的却是活人之妻。

text.en: Du Ji's son Du Shu succeeded him as marquis.
text.zht: 杜畿之子杜恕襲爵。
text.zhs: 杜畿之子杜恕袭爵。

text.en: Du Ji was on good terms with Li Hui, the Minister Coachman, and lamented after meeting his son Li Feng that Li Hui's house might soon perish; Li Feng was later executed with his father's household.
text.zht: 杜畿與太僕李恢交好，見其子李豐後感嘆李恢之家恐將覆亡；後來李豐果然被誅。
text.zhs: 杜畿与太仆李恢交好，见其子李丰后感叹李恢之家恐将覆亡；后来李丰果然被诛。

text.en: Du Ji was on good terms with Guo Zhi, Grand Administrator of Dong'an, and predicted his son Guo Chong would carry on the family legacy, as he did.
text.zht: 杜畿與東安太守郭智交好，預言其子郭沖能繼承家業，後來果然如此。
text.zhs: 杜畿与东安太守郭智交好，预言其子郭冲能继承家业，后来果然如此。

text.en: Li Hui's son Li Feng became renowned for his talent but was executed together with his father's household; another account gives Li Feng's father the name Yi, perhaps an alternative name for Hui.
text.zht: 李恢之子李豐以才智聞名天下，後與父兄同被誅殺；另有說法稱李豐之父名義，或為恢之別名。
text.zhs: 李恢之子李丰以才智闻名天下，后与父兄同被诛杀；另有说法称李丰之父名义，或为恢之别名。

text.en: Guo Zhi's son Guo Chong became Grand Administrator of Dai and carried on his father's career.
text.zht: 郭智之子郭沖官至代郡太守，繼承父業。
text.zhs: 郭智之子郭冲官至代郡太守，继承父业。

position.en: Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat

orig.zht: 杜畿字伯侯，[[京兆杜陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]人也。少孤，繼母苦之，以孝聞。年二十，為[[郡功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，[[守|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-interim]][[鄭縣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.52728749&lng=109.77084398&name=Zheng]][[令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。縣囚繫數百人，畿親臨獄，裁其輕重，盡決遣之，雖未悉當，郡中奇其年少而有大意也。
orig.zhs: 杜畿字伯侯，[[京兆杜陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]人也。少孤，继母苦之，以孝闻。年二十，为[[郡功曹|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，[[守|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-interim]][[郑县|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.52728749&lng=109.77084398&name=Zheng]][[令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。县囚系数百人，畿亲临狱，裁其轻重，尽决遣之，虽未悉当，郡中奇其年少而有大意也。

vern.zht: 杜畿字伯侯，是[[京兆杜陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]人。年幼喪父，繼母虐待他，他卻以孝順聞名。二十歲時，擔任[[郡功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，代理[[鄭縣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.52728749&lng=109.77084398&name=Zheng]]縣[[令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。縣監獄裏關押着幾百名囚犯，杜畿親自到獄中，衡量他們罪行的輕重，全部判決發落；雖然未必都判得恰當，郡中的人都對他年紀輕卻很有主見感到驚奇。
vern.zhs: 杜畿字伯侯，是[[京兆杜陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]人。年幼丧父，继母虐待他，他却以孝顺闻名。二十岁时，担任[[郡功曹|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，代理[[郑县|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.52728749&lng=109.77084398&name=Zheng]]县[[令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。县监狱里关押着几百名囚犯，杜畿亲自到狱中，衡量他们罪行的轻重，全部判决发落；虽然未必都判得恰当，郡中的人都对他年纪轻却很有主见感到惊奇。

passages.en: Du Ji, courtesy name Bohou, was from [[Du, Jingzhao|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]. Orphaned young, he was harshly treated by his stepmother, yet became known for his filial devotion. At twenty, Du Ji served as [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]] in the commandery and [[interim|/translations/officials#glossary-interim]] [[County Magistrate|/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]] of [[Zheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.52728749&lng=109.77084398&name=Zheng]]. Several hundred prisoners were then held in the county jail. Du Ji personally examined their cases, weighed the gravity of each offence, adjudicated each case, and released those whose circumstances warranted it. Though not every decision was entirely just, the commandery marvelled that, at so young an age, he already possessed such lofty ambitions.

source.en: Fu Zi / The Book of Master Fu

vern.zht: 《傅子》記載：杜畿，是漢朝御史大夫杜延年的後代。杜延年的父親杜周，從[[南陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=85]]遷徙到茂陵，杜延年遷到[[杜陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]，子孫世代居住在那裏。[^1]
vern.zhs: 《傅子》记载：杜畿，是汉朝御史大夫杜延年的后代。杜延年的父亲杜周，从[[南阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=85]]迁徙到茂陵，杜延年迁到[[杜陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]]，子孙世代居住在那里。[^1]

annotations.en: The Fu Zi / Book of Master Fu states: Du Ji was a descendant of Du Yannian, an Imperial Censor under the Han. Du Yannian's father, Du Zhou, moved from [[Nanyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=85]] to Maoling; Du Yannian later moved to [[Duling|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.21174681&lng=109.02506097&name=Du]], where his descendants lived for generations.[^1]

passages.en: Du Ji was nominated as [[Filial and Incorrupt|/translations/officials#glossary-filial-and-incorrupt]] and appointed as an [[Assistant to the Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-040]] of [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]. When disorder swept the realm, he abandoned his office and took refuge in [[Jing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=2]], returning only during the Jian'an era. Xun Yu recommended him to Cao Cao, who appointed him [[Rectifier|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-006]] under the [[Excellency of Works|/translations/officials/ministers#three-excellencies-105]].[^1] Du Ji was later [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[Colonel Protecting the Qiang|/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]], made [[Envoy Bearing the Imperial Tally|/translations/officials#glossary-envoy-bearing-the-imperial-tally]], and [[concurrently|/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]] appointed [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Xiping|/maps/map-overall?admin=140]].

footnotes.en: At that time, Cao Cao was the [[Excellency of Works|/translations/officials/ministers#three-excellencies-105]].

annotations.en: The Fu Zi / Book of Master Fu states: Du Ji returned from [[Jing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=2]] and later reached [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]], where he met the [[Palace Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]] Geng Ji and conversed with him throughout the night. The [[Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-031]] Xun Yu lived next door to Geng Ji. Hearing what Du Ji said that night, Xun Yu was much impressed. At dawn, he sent someone to Geng Ji: "You know a man of outstanding talent, yet fail to recommend him. How can you remain in office?" When Xun Yu met Du Ji, he understood him as though they had long been acquainted, and promptly recommended him to the court.

annotations.zht: 《魏略》曰：畿少有大志。在[[荊州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]數歲，繼母亡後，以[[三輔|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]]開通，負其母喪北歸。道為賊所劫略，衆人奔走，畿獨不去。賊射之，畿請賊曰：「卿欲得財耳，今我無物，用射我何為邪？」賊乃止。畿到鄉里，[[京兆|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]尹張時，[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]人也，與畿有舊，[[署|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-deputise]]為[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]。嘗嫌其闊達，不助留意於諸事，言此家疏誕，不中[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]也。畿竊云：「不中[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，中[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]也。」

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：杜畿年少時就有遠大志向，在[[荊州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]幾年後，他的繼母去世了。後來因爲[[三輔|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]]地區道路暢通，他揹着繼母的靈柩向北返回，在路上被賊寇劫掠，衆人都逃走了，只有他不離開，賊寇就向他射箭。杜畿向盜賊請求道：“你們想要錢財罷了，現在我什麼都沒有，射我幹什麼呢？”盜賊於是停止了射箭。杜畿回到家鄉，[[京兆|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]尹張時是[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]人，和他有舊交情，就任用他做[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]。張時曾經嫌棄他豁達不拘小節，不協助處理事務，便點評杜畿這個人做事粗疏放誕，不適合擔任[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]。杜畿私下說：“我不適合擔任[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，卻適合擔任[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。”

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Du Ji had lofty ambitions from an early age. He spent several years in [[Jing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]. After his stepmother died and the routes to the [[Three Capital Regions|/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]] reopened, he carried her coffin north back to his homeland. On the way, bandits attacked and plundered the travellers. Everyone else fled, but Du Ji alone remained. When the bandits shot at him, he called out, "You merely want wealth, and I have nothing, so why shoot me?" The bandits then desisted. Upon Du Ji's return home, Zhang Shi, the Intendant of [[Jingzhao|/maps/map-overall?admin=142]], was in office. A native of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] and an old acquaintance, he [[temporarily appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-deputise]] Du Ji his [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]. Yet Zhang Shi disliked Du Ji for being too free and easy in temperament and for paying little attention to affairs. He remarked that Du Ji was derelict and undisciplined, and not fit to be [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]. Du Ji privately said, "I may not be fit to be [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]], but I am fit to be [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]."

vern.zht: 太祖平定[[河|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=265]]北後，高幹卻在[[幷州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=0]]舉兵反叛。當時[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]王邑被徵召，[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]人衛固、範先表面上以請求王邑留任爲名，背地裏卻與高幹串通密謀。太祖對荀彧說：“[[關西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]諸將倚仗險要地形和騎兵，如果征討他們，必定會作亂。張晟在殽、[[澠|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.46873726&lng=111.46934986&name=黽池]]之間侵擾，向南勾結劉表；衛固等人也借他的聲勢，我擔心他們爲害會很深。[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]依山環河，四鄰多有變亂，是當今天下的要地。您替我舉薦蕭何、寇恂那樣的人來鎮守那裏。”荀彧說：“杜畿就是這樣的人。”於是太祖追授杜畿爲[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。
vern.zhs: 太祖平定[[河|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=265]]北后，高干却在[[并州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=0]]举兵反叛。当时[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]王邑被征召，[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]人卫固、范先表面上以请求王邑留任为名，背地里却与高干串通密谋。太祖对荀彧说：“[[关西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]诸将倚仗险要地形和骑兵，如果征讨他们，必定会作乱。张晟在殽、[[渑|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.46873726&lng=111.46934986&name=黽池]]之间侵扰，向南勾结刘表；卫固等人也借他的声势，我担心他们为害会很深。[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]依山环河，四邻多有变乱，是当今天下的要地。您替我举荐萧何、寇恂那样的人来镇守那里。”荀彧说：“杜畿就是这样的人。”于是太祖追授杜畿为[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。

passages.en: After Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor) had pacified the region north of the [[Yellow River|/maps/map-overall?water=265]], Gao Gan raised [[Bing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=0]] in rebellion. At the time, Wang Yi, [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]], had been [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] to court. Wei Gu and Fan Xian of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] publicly petitioned for Wang Yi to remain in office, but were secretly plotting with Gao Gan. Cao Cao said to Xun Yu, "The generals [[West of the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]] rely on the rugged terrain and their cavalry. If summoned, they will surely rebel. Zhang Sheng is raiding the region between Mount Yao and [[Mianchi|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.46873726&lng=111.46934986&name=黽池]], and has established contact with Liu Biao to the south. With Wei Gu and the others taking advantage of this, I fear they may do great harm. [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] is enclosed by mountains and rivers, while unrest abounds on every side. It is now a key strategic region of the realm. I wish for you to recommend a Xiao He or Kou Xun to hold it." Xun Yu replied, "Du Ji is the man." Cao Cao therefore recalled Du Ji and [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] him [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]].

orig.zht: 固等使兵數千人絕[[陝津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.8005&lng=111.1228&name=Shanjin]]，畿至不得渡。太祖遣夏侯惇討之，未至。彧謂畿曰：「宜須大兵。」畿曰：「[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]有三萬戶，非皆欲為亂也。今兵迫之急，欲為善者無主，必懼而聽於固。固等勢專，必以死戰。討之不勝，四鄰應之，天下之變未息也；討之而勝，是殘一郡之民也。且固等未顯絕王命，外以請故君為名，必不害新君。吾單車直往，出其不意。固為人多計而無斷，必偽受吾。吾得居郡一月，以計縻之，足矣。」遂詭道從[[郖津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.68352043&lng=110.86352877&name=Doujin]]度。
orig.zhs: 固等使兵数千人绝[[陕津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.8005&lng=111.1228&name=Shanjin]]，畿至不得渡。太祖遣夏侯惇讨之，未至。彧谓畿曰：「宜须大兵。」畿曰：「[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]有三万户，非皆欲为乱也。今兵迫之急，欲为善者无主，必惧而听于固。固等势专，必以死战。讨之不胜，四邻应之，天下之变未息也；讨之而胜，是残一郡之民也。且固等未显绝王命，外以请故君为名，必不害新君。吾单车直往，出其不意。固为人多计而无断，必伪受吾。吾得居郡一月，以计縻之，足矣。」遂诡道从[[郖津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.68352043&lng=110.86352877&name=Doujin]]度。

vern.zht: 衛固等人派數千名士兵截斷[[陝津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.8005&lng=111.1228&name=Shanjin]]渡口，杜畿到達後無法渡河。太祖派夏侯惇討伐他們，夏侯惇還未到達。荀彧對杜畿說：“應當等待大軍。”杜畿說：“[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]有三萬戶人家，並非人人都想作亂。如今軍隊把他們逼得太急，想做好事的人沒有領頭的人，必定因恐懼而聽從衛固。衛固等人的勢力一旦集中，必定會拼死作戰。討伐他們如果不能取勝，四鄰就會響應他們，天下的變亂就不會平息；討伐他們如果取勝，這也是殘害一郡的百姓。況且衛固等人還沒有公開抗拒朝廷的命令，表面上以請求原來的太守爲名，一定不會加害新任太守。我獨自乘車徑直前往，出其不意。衛固爲人計謀多而缺乏決斷，一定會假裝接受我。我能在郡中待上一個月，用計策牽制住他，就足夠了。”於是改走隱祕的小路，從[[郖津|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.68352043&lng=110.86352877&name=Doujin]]渡過河。
vern.zhs: 卫固等人派数千名士兵截断[[陕津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.8005&lng=111.1228&name=Shanjin]]渡口，杜畿到达后无法渡河。太祖派夏侯惇讨伐他们，夏侯惇还未到达。荀彧对杜畿说：“应当等待大军。”杜畿说：“[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]有三万户人家，并非人人都想作乱。如今军队把他们逼得太急，想做好事的人没有领头的人，必定因恐惧而听从卫固。卫固等人的势力一旦集中，必定会拼死作战。讨伐他们如果不能取胜，四邻就会响应他们，天下的变乱就不会平息；讨伐他们如果取胜，这也是残害一郡的百姓。况且卫固等人还没有公开抗拒朝廷的命令，表面上以请求原来的太守为名，一定不会加害新任太守。我独自乘车径直前往，出其不意。卫固为人计谋多而缺乏决断，一定会假装接受我。我能在郡中待上一个月，用计策牵制住他，就足够了。”于是改走隐秘的小路，从[[郖津|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.68352043&lng=110.86352877&name=Doujin]]渡过河。

passages.en: Wei Gu and his followers sent several thousand troops to block [[Shanjin|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.8005&lng=111.1228&name=Shanjin]], preventing Du Ji from crossing. Cao Cao sent Xiahou Dun against them, but he had not yet arrived. Xun Yu said to Du Ji, "You should wait for the main army." Du Ji replied, "[[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] has thirty thousand households, and not all wish to rebel. If we press them hard with troops, those who wish to remain loyal will have no leader. In fear, they will submit to Wei Gu. Once Wei Gu and his followers have secured sole control, they will fight to the death. If the campaign against them failed, the neighbouring regions would rise in response, and turmoil throughout the realm would not cease. If the campaign succeeded, we would have ravaged the people of an entire commandery. Moreover, Wei Gu and his followers have not openly defied the imperial command. Their declared cause is the retention of their former administrator, so they will surely not harm the new one. I shall go directly there in a single carriage and take them by surprise. Wei Gu is full of schemes but incapable of decision. He will feign acceptance of me. If I can remain in the commandery for a month, that will be enough to bring him under control by strategic manoeuvres." Du Ji then took a circuitous route and crossed at [[Doujin|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.68352043&lng=110.86352877&name=Doujin]].

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：當初，杜畿和衛固年少時相互輕慢戲弄，衛固曾經輕視杜畿。杜畿曾經和衛固一起下棋並爭論棋路，杜畿曾對衛固說：“仲堅[^1]，我如今可要治理[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]了。”衛固撩起衣服罵他。等到杜畿到任，衛固擔任郡[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]。張時過去曾擔任[[京兆|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]尹，杜畿去迎接[[司隸|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]校尉，和張時在[[華陰|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5574832&lng=110.08263445&name=Huayin]]相會，按當時的禮儀，各自手持笏板。張時感嘆說：“昨天還是郡裏的[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]，今天就成了郡守了！”

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Previously, Du Ji and Wei Gu had been familiar with one another from a young age, and Wei Gu often treated Du Ji with contempt. Once, while the two were playing a board game and disputing a move, Du Ji said, "Zhongjian,[^1] I am now administrator of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]." Wei Gu hitched up his robes and cursed him. When Du Ji later took up the post, Wei Gu became the commandery's [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]. Zhang Shi had formerly been Intendant of [[Jingzhao|/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]. When Du Ji went to welcome the [[Colonel of the Capital|/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]], he met Zhang Shi at [[Huayin|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5574832&lng=110.08263445&name=Huayin]]. By protocol, each was required to carry his official tablet when they met. Zhang Shi sighed, "Yesterday a [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]], today a commandery's governor!"

footnotes.en: Wei Gu's courtesy name was Zhongjian.

orig.zht: 范先欲殺畿以威衆。且觀畿去就，於門下斬殺[[主簿|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-051]]已下三十餘人，畿舉動自若。於是固曰：「殺之無損，徒有惡名；且制之在我。」遂奉之。畿謂衞固、范先曰：「衞、范，[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]之望也，吾仰成而已。然君臣有定義，成敗同之，大事當共平議。」以固為都督，[[行|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-acting]][[丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-040]]事，[[領|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]][[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]；將校吏兵三千餘人，皆范先督之。固等喜，雖陽事畿，不以為意。固欲大發兵，畿患之，說固曰：「夫欲為非常之事，不可動衆心。今大發兵，衆必擾，不如徐以貲募兵。」
orig.zhs: 范先欲杀畿以威众。且观畿去就，于门下斩杀[[主簿|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-051]]已下三十余人，畿举动自若。于是固曰：「杀之无损，徒有恶名；且制之在我。」遂奉之。畿谓卫固、范先曰：「卫、范，[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]之望也，吾仰成而已。然君臣有定义，成败同之，大事当共平议。」以固为都督，[[行|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-acting]][[丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-040]]事，[[领|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]][[功曹|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]；将校吏兵三千余人，皆范先督之。固等喜，虽阳事畿，不以为意。固欲大发兵，畿患之，说固曰：「夫欲为非常之事，不可动众心。今大发兵，众必扰，不如徐以赀募兵。」

vern.zht: 範先想殺杜畿來威懾衆人，並想觀察杜畿的反應，在門前斬殺了[[主簿|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-051]]以下三十多人；杜畿卻泰然自若。於是衛固說：“殺了他對我們並無損害，只會白白留下惡名；況且控制他的權力在我們手裏。”於是便擁戴他。杜畿對衛固、範先說：“衛、範二位是[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]有名望的人，我不過是仰仗你們成事罷了。然而君臣之間有固定的名分，成敗要共同承擔，大事應當共同商議。”杜畿任命衛固爲都督，代理郡[[丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-040]]事務，兼任[[功曹|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]；將校、吏員、士兵三千多人，都歸範先統率。衛固等人很高興，雖然表面上事奉杜畿，卻不把他放在心上。衛固想要大規模徵發軍隊，杜畿很憂慮，勸衛固說：“想要做不尋常的事，就不能動搖衆人的心。如今大規模發兵，衆人必定驚擾，不如慢慢地用錢財招募士兵。”
vern.zhs: 范先想杀杜畿来威慑众人，并想观察杜畿的反应，在门前斩杀了[[主簿|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-051]]以下三十多人；杜畿却泰然自若。于是卫固说：“杀了他对我们并无损害，只会白白留下恶名；况且控制他的权力在我们手里。”于是便拥戴他。杜畿对卫固、范先说：“卫、范二位是[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]有名望的人，我不过是仰仗你们成事罢了。然而君臣之间有固定的名分，成败要共同承担，大事应当共同商议。”杜畿任命卫固为都督，代理郡[[丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-040]]事务，兼任[[功曹|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]]；将校、吏员、士兵三千多人，都归范先统率。卫固等人很高兴，虽然表面上事奉杜畿，却不把他放在心上。卫固想要大规模征发军队，杜畿很忧虑，劝卫固说：“想要做不寻常的事，就不能动摇众人的心。如今大规模发兵，众人必定惊扰，不如慢慢地用钱财招募士兵。”

passages.en: Fan Xian initially wished to kill Du Ji to establish his authority over the populace, but also wanted to see what course Du Ji would take. He therefore had more than thirty officials, from the [[Registrar|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-051]] down, beheaded at the gate before Du Ji. Du Ji remained perfectly composed. Wei Gu then said, "Killing him would gain us nothing and merely earn us a bad name. Besides, he is under my control." They therefore acknowledged Du Ji's authority. Du Ji said to Wei Gu and Fan Xian, "Your clans are the leading families of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]. I need only rely on you to see matters accomplished. Yet sovereign and subject have fixed obligations, and we must share success or failure. Major affairs should be discussed and decided together." Du Ji appointed Wei Gu as Commander, [[acting|/translations/officials#glossary-acting]] as the commandery [[Assistant|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-040]], and [[concurrently|/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]] [[Merit Section Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-049]], while placing all the military officers, officials, and troops of more than three thousand, under Fan Xian's command. Wei Gu and the others were delighted. Though they nominally served Du Ji, they paid him little heed. Wei Gu wished to raise troops on a large scale. Troubled by this, Du Ji persuaded him, saying, "Anyone who seeks to undertake the extraordinary must not alarm the people. A mass levy now would inevitably cause unrest. It would be better to recruit troops gradually with money."

source.en: Fu Zi / The Book of Master Fu

orig.zht: 固以為然，從之，遂為貲調發，數十日乃定，諸將貪多應募而少遣兵。又入喻固等曰：「人情顧家，諸將掾史，可分遣休息，急緩召之不難。」固等惡逆衆心，又從之。於是善人在外，陰為己援；惡人分散，各還其家，則衆離矣。會白騎攻[[東垣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.17529361&lng=111.78118056&name=Dongyuan]][^1]，高幹入[[濩澤|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.4950886&lng=112.24702337&name=Huoze]]，[[上黨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]諸縣殺長吏，[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]執[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，固等密調兵未至。
orig.zhs: 固以为然，从之，遂为赀调发，数十日乃定，诸将贪多应募而少遣兵。又入喻固等曰：「人情顾家，诸将掾史，可分遣休息，急缓召之不难。」固等恶逆众心，又从之。于是善人在外，阴为己援；恶人分散，各还其家，则众离矣。会白骑攻[[东垣|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.17529361&lng=111.78118056&name=Dongyuan]][^1]，高幹入[[濩泽|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.4950886&lng=112.24702337&name=Huoze]]，[[上党|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]诸县杀长吏，[[弘农|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]执[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，固等密调兵未至。

vern.zht: 衛固認爲杜畿說得對，聽從了他，於是用錢財徵調兵員，幾十天才定下來；將領們貪圖錢財而多招士兵，應募的人雖多，派出的卻很少。杜畿又進去勸告衛固等人說：“人之常情是顧念家庭，各位將領、掾史，可以分批讓他們回去休息，有緊急情況再召集他們也不難。”衛固等人不願違背衆人心意，又聽從了他。於是良善的人留在外面，暗中成爲杜畿的援助；惡人被分散，各自回到家中，他們的部衆就離散了。恰逢張白騎攻打[[東垣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.17529361&lng=111.78118056&name=Dongyuan]][^1]，高幹進入[[濩澤|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.4950886&lng=112.24702337&name=Huoze]]，[[上黨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]各縣殺死長吏，[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]拘捕[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，衛固等人暗中調動的軍隊還沒有到。
vern.zhs: 卫固认为杜畿说得对，听从了他，于是用钱财征调兵员，几十天才定下来；将领们贪图钱财而多招士兵，应募的人虽多，派出的却很少。杜畿又进去劝告卫固等人说：“人之常情是顾念家庭，各位将领、掾史，可以分批让他们回去休息，有紧急情况再召集他们也不难。”卫固等人不愿违背众人心意，又听从了他。于是良善的人留在外面，暗中成为杜畿的援助；恶人被分散，各自回到家中，他们的部众就离散了。恰逢张白骑攻打[[东垣|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.17529361&lng=111.78118056&name=Dongyuan]][^1]，高干进入[[濩泽|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.4950886&lng=112.24702337&name=Huoze]]，[[上党|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]各县杀死长吏，[[弘农|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]拘捕[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，卫固等人暗中调动的军队还没有到。

passages.en: Wei Gu agreed and followed Du Ji's advice. He then assessed the households and organised the levy, a process that took several dozen days. The commanders, eager to claim rewards, pledged many recruits but sent few troops. Du Ji again went to Wei Gu and the others and advised them: "Men naturally care for their families. The officers and clerks may be sent home in separate groups to rest. It will not be difficult to recall them when the need arises." Wei Gu and the others feared antagonising the men and again followed his advice. Thus, the loyal men remained outside and secretly lent Du Ji support, while the disloyal dispersed and returned to their homes. Their following consequently fell apart. Just then, Baiqi attacked [[Dongyuan|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.17529361&lng=111.78118056&name=Dongyuan]] in Hedong,[^1] Gao Gan entered [[Huoze|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.4950886&lng=112.24702337&name=Huoze]], the counties of [[Shangdang|/maps/map-overall?admin=17]] killed their chief officials, and men in [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?admin=54]] seized the [[commandery administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]], while the troops secretly summoned by Wei Gu and the others had yet to arrive.

orig.zht: 畿知諸縣附己，因出，單將數十騎，赴張辟拒守[^1]，吏民多舉城助畿者，比數十日，得四千餘人。固等與幹、晟共攻畿，不下，略諸縣，無所得。會大兵至，幹、晟敗，固等伏誅，其餘黨與皆赦之，使復其居業。
orig.zhs: 畿知诸县附己，因出，单将数十骑，赴张辟拒守[^1]，吏民多举城助畿者，比数十日，得四千余人。固等与干、晟共攻畿，不下，略诸县，无所得。会大兵至，干、晟败，固等伏诛，其余党与皆赦之，使复其居业。

vern.zht: 杜畿知道各縣都歸附自己，於是出城，只率領幾十名騎兵，前往張辟據守[^1]。許多官民以全城之力幫助杜畿，過了幾十天，得到四千多人。衛固等人與高幹、張晟一起攻打杜畿，未能攻下，就掠奪各縣，但沒有得到什麼。適逢大軍到達，高幹、張晟戰敗，衛固等人被誅殺，他們的餘黨都獲得赦免，並被允許恢復原來的住所和產業。
vern.zhs: 杜畿知道各县都归附自己，于是出城，只率领几十名骑兵，前往张辟据守[^1]。许多官民以全城之力帮助杜畿，过了几十天，得到四千多人。卫固等人与高干、张晟一起攻打杜畿，未能攻下，就掠夺各县，但没有得到什么。适逢大军到达，高干、张晟战败，卫固等人被诛杀，他们的余党都获得赦免，并被允许恢复原来的住所和产业。

passages.en: Du Ji knew that the various counties supported him, so he set out with only a few dozen horsemen and hastened to Zhangbi.[^1] They held out against the rebels, and many officials and commoners brought whole towns over to support Du Ji. Within a few dozen days Du Ji had gathered more than four thousand men. Wei Gu and the others joined Gao Gan and Zhang Sheng in attacking him, but could not defeat him. They raided the counties but gained nothing. When the main army arrived, Gao Gan and Zhang Sheng were defeated, and Wei Gu and the others were executed. All their remaining followers were pardoned and allowed to return to their homes and occupations.

orig.zht: 是時天下郡縣皆殘破，[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]最先定，少耗減。畿治之，崇寬惠，與民無為。民嘗辭訟，有相告者，畿親見為陳大義，遣令歸諦思之，若意有所不盡，更來詣府。鄉邑父老自相責怒曰：「有君如此，柰何不從其教？」自是少有辭訟。班下屬縣，舉孝子、貞婦、順孫，復其繇役，隨時慰勉之。漸課民畜牸牛、草馬，下逮雞豚犬豕，皆有章程。百姓勤農，家家豐實。畿乃曰：「民富矣，不可不教也。」於是冬月脩戎講武，又開學宮，親自執經教授，郡中化之。
orig.zhs: 是时天下郡县皆残破，[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]最先定，少耗减。畿治之，崇宽惠，与民无为。民尝辞讼，有相告者，畿亲见为陈大义，遣令归谛思之，若意有所不尽，更来诣府。乡邑父老自相责怒曰：「有君如此，柰何不从其教？」自是少有辞讼。班下属县，举孝子、贞妇、顺孙，复其繇役，随时慰勉之。渐课民畜牸牛、草马，下逮鸡豚犬豕，皆有章程。百姓勤农，家家丰实。畿乃曰：「民富矣，不可不教也。」于是冬月修戎讲武，又开学宫，亲自执经教授，郡中化之。

vern.zht: 當時天下各郡縣都殘破，[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]郡最先平定，損失較少。杜畿治理[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，崇尚寬厚惠民，讓百姓休養生息而不加煩擾。百姓中曾有打官司、相互告狀的，杜畿親自接見，向他們講明大義，讓他們回去仔細思考；如果還有話沒有說完，就再到府中來。鄉邑的父老們彼此生氣地責備說：“有這樣好的長官，爲什麼不聽從他的教誨？”從此以後，訴訟就少了。杜畿向所屬各縣頒佈命令，要求推舉孝子、貞婦、順孫，免除他們的徭役，並隨時慰問勉勵他們。他逐漸督促百姓畜養母牛、母馬，下至雞、豬、狗等，都訂有章程。百姓勤於農事，家家富足殷實。杜畿於是說：“百姓富足了，不可不加以教化。”於是在冬季整飭武備、講習武事，又開設學校，親自拿着經書教授，郡中因此受到教化。
vern.zhs: 当时天下各郡县都残破，[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]郡最先平定，损失较少。杜畿治理[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，崇尚宽厚惠民，让百姓休养生息而不加烦扰。百姓中曾有打官司、相互告状的，杜畿亲自接见，向他们讲明大义，让他们回去仔细思考；如果还有话没有说完，就再到府中来。乡邑的父老们彼此生气地责备说：“有这样好的长官，为什么不听从他的教诲？”从此以后，诉讼就少了。杜畿向所属各县颁布命令，要求推举孝子、贞妇、顺孙，免除他们的徭役，并随时慰问勉励他们。他逐渐督促百姓畜养母牛、母马，下至鸡、猪、狗等，都订有章程。百姓勤于农事，家家富足殷实。杜畿于是说：“百姓富足了，不可不加以教化。”于是在冬季整饬武备、讲习武事，又开设学校，亲自拿着经书教授，郡中因此受到教化。

passages.en: At this time, the commanderies and counties throughout the realm lay devastated. [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] was the first to be pacified and had suffered comparatively little depletion. Du Ji governed with leniency and benevolence, interfering as little as possible in the people's affairs. Whenever disputes arose and accusations were brought before him, he received the parties in person and explained the grand principles at stake. He then sent them home to reflect carefully, telling them that if they still felt the matter unresolved, they might return to his office. The village elders reproached one another, saying, "With such a governor, how can we fail to heed his teaching?" Thereafter, lawsuits became rare. Du Ji issued orders to the subordinate counties to identify filial sons, chaste women, and dutiful grandsons. He exempted them from corvée, and often commended and encouraged them. He gradually led the people to rear cows and horses, as well as chickens, dogs, and swine, all according to prescribed regulations. The people applied themselves to farming, and every household prospered. Du Ji then said, "The people are now prosperous; they must also be taught." During the winter months, he conducted military training and instructed them in warfare. He also established schools, where he personally expounded the Classics. The whole commandery was transformed by his example.

source.en: Weilüe / Brief History of Wei (Yu Huan)

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: The Erudite Yue Xiang owed his advancement to Du Ji. To this day, [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] has an exceptional number of scholars, and this too is Du Ji's doing.

orig.zht: 韓遂、馬超之叛也，[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]、[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]多舉縣邑以應之。[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]雖與賊接，民無異心。太祖西征至[[蒲阪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=蒲坂]]，與賊夾[[渭|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=14]]為軍，軍食一仰[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]。及賊破，餘畜二十餘萬[[斛|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-hu]]。太祖下令曰：「[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]杜畿，孔子所謂『禹，吾無閒然矣』[^1]。增秩中二千[[石|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-shi]]。」太祖征[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，遣五千人運，運者自率勉曰：「人生有一死，不可負我府君。」終無一人逃亡，其得人心如此。

vern.zht: 韓遂、馬超反叛時，[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]、[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]的許多縣邑起而響應他們。[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]雖然與賊境相接，百姓卻沒有二心。太祖西征到達[[蒲阪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=蒲坂]]，與賊軍隔着[[渭|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=14]]水紮營對峙，軍糧完全依賴[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]供應。等到賊軍被擊敗，剩餘積蓄還有二十餘萬[[斛|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-hu]]。太祖下令說：“[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]杜畿，就是孔子所說的‘禹，我對他沒有什麼可非議的了’[^1]。把他的俸祿提升爲中二千[[石|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-shi]]。”太祖征討[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，派了五千人從事運輸。運送的人自發地互相勉勵說：“人生總有一死，不能辜負我們的府君。”最終沒有一個人逃亡，他得人心到了這種程度。
vern.zhs: 韩遂、马超反叛时，[[弘农|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]、[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]的许多县邑起而响应他们。[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]虽然与贼境相接，百姓却没有二心。太祖西征到达[[蒲阪|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=蒲坂]]，与贼军隔着[[渭|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=14]]水扎营对峙，军粮完全依赖[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]供应。等到贼军被击败，剩余积蓄还有二十余万[[斛|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-hu]]。太祖下令说：“[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]杜畿，就是孔子所说的‘禹，我对他没有什么可非议的了’[^1]。把他的俸禄提升为中二千[[石|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-shi]]。”太祖征讨[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，派了五千人从事运输。运送的人自发地互相勉励说：“人生总有一死，不能辜负我们的府君。”最终没有一个人逃亡，他得人心到了这种程度。

passages.en: When Han Sui and Ma Chao rebelled, many counties and towns in [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?admin=54]] and [[Pingyi|/maps/map-overall?admin=151]] rose in support. Though [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] bordered rebel territory, its people remained loyal. Cao Cao marched west to [[Puban|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84242176&lng=110.29953942&name=蒲坂]] and encamped across the [[Wei River|/maps/map-overall?water=14]] from the rebels. His army depended entirely on [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] for provisions. After the rebels were defeated, more than 200000 [[Hu|/translations/officials#glossary-hu]] remained in store. Cao Cao issued an order: "Du Ji, [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]], is a man of whom Confucius might have said, 'As for Yu, I can find no fault in him.'[^1] Let his rank be raised to the Fully 2000 [[Shi|/translations/officials#glossary-shi]]." When Cao Cao campaigned in [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]], Du Ji sent five thousand men to transport supplies. The men encouraged one another, saying, "A man must die but once. We cannot fail our commandery lord." Not one of them deserted. Such was Du Ji's hold on the hearts of the people.

annotations.zht: 《杜氏新書》曰：[[平虜將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-125]]劉勳，為太祖所親，貴震朝廷。嘗從畿求大棗，畿拒以他故。後勳伏法，太祖得其書，歎曰：「杜畿可謂『不媚於竈』者也。[^1]」稱畿功美，以下州郡，曰：「昔仲尼之於顏子，每言不能不歎，旣情愛發中，又宜率馬以驥。今吾亦冀衆人仰高山，慕景行也。」
annotations.zhs: 《杜氏新书》曰：[[平虏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-125]]刘勋，为太祖所亲，贵震朝廷。尝从畿求大枣，畿拒以他故。后勋伏法，太祖得其书，叹曰：「杜畿可谓『不媚于灶』者也。[^1]」称畿功美，以下州郡，曰：「昔仲尼之于颜子，每言不能不叹，既情爱发中，又宜率马以骥。今吾亦冀众人仰高山，慕景行也。」

vern.zht: 《杜氏新書》記載：[[平虜將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-125]]劉勳深受太祖親近，其顯貴威震朝廷。劉勳曾經向杜畿索要大棗，杜畿用別的理由拒絕了他。後來劉勳被依法處死。太祖收到那封信，嘆息着說：“杜畿可以說是‘不媚於竈’的人了。[^1]”太祖稱讚杜畿的功勞和美德，向州郡下達命令說：“從前孔子對於顏子，每次談到他都不能不讚嘆。這既是心中對他的喜愛之情，也是相以良馬引領劣馬。現在我也希望衆人能敬仰他高尚的品德，仰慕他美好的德行。”
vern.zhs: 《杜氏新书》记载：[[平虏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-125]]刘勋深受太祖亲近，其显贵威震朝廷。刘勋曾经向杜畿索要大枣，杜畿用别的理由拒绝了他。后来刘勋被依法处死。太祖收到那封信，叹息着说：“杜畿可以说是‘不媚于灶’的人了。[^1]”太祖称赞杜畿的功劳和美德，向州郡下达命令说：“从前孔子对于颜子，每次谈到他都不能不赞叹。这既是心中对他的喜爱之情，也是相以良马引领劣马。现在我也希望众人能敬仰他高尚的品德，仰慕他美好的德行。”

annotations.en: The Du Shi Xinshu / New Book of Du Clan states: Liu Xun, [[General Who Subdues the Enemies|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-125]], was a favourite of Cao Cao, and his influence awed the court. He once asked Du Ji for some large jujubes, but Du Ji put him off with an excuse. After Liu Xun was executed, Cao Cao found his letter and sighed, "Du Ji may truly be called one who 'does not curry favour with the stove'.[^1]" Cao Cao commended Du Ji's meritorious conduct in a proclamation circulated to the provinces and commanderies: "In former days, whenever Confucius spoke of Yan Hui, he could not help but praise him. This was not only because affection welled up from his heart, but also because he wished to set him forth as the finest steed at the head of the herd. I too hope that all men will look up to the lofty mountain and aspire to the noble path of Du Ji."

orig.zht: 魏國旣建，以畿為[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。事平，更有令曰：「昔蕭何定[[關中|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]，寇恂平[[河內|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]，卿有功，閒將授卿以納言之職；顧念[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]吾股肱郡，充實之所，足以制天下，故且煩卿卧鎮之。」畿在[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]十六年，常為天下最。
orig.zhs: 魏国既建，以畿为[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。事平，更有令曰：「昔萧何定[[关中|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]，寇恂平[[河内|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]，卿有功，闲将授卿以纳言之职；顾念[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]吾股肱郡，充实之所，足以制天下，故且烦卿卧镇之。」畿在[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]十六年，常为天下最。

vern.zht: 魏國建立以後，任命杜畿爲[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。事情平定後，又下令說：“從前蕭何安定[[關中|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]，寇恂平定[[河內|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]，您有功勞；我近來正要授予您納言之職。只是考慮到[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]是我股肱之郡，是富足充實的地方，足以控制天下，所以暫且煩勞您安臥鎮守那裏。”杜畿在[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]十六年，政績常爲天下第一。
vern.zhs: 魏国建立以后，任命杜畿为[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。事情平定后，又下令说：“从前萧何安定[[关中|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]，寇恂平定[[河内|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]，您有功劳；我近来正要授予您纳言之职。只是考虑到[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]是我股肱之郡，是富足充实的地方，足以控制天下，所以暂且烦劳您安卧镇守那里。”杜畿在[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]十六年，政绩常为天下第一。

passages.en: When the kingdom of Wei was established, Du Ji was appointed to the [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]. After affairs had been settled, a further decree was issued: "In former times, Xiao He secured the region [[Inside the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]] and Kou Xun pacified [[Henei|/maps/map-overall?admin=55]]. You, my minister, too have rendered distinguished service, and I had intended to give you a post charged with remonstrance. Yet [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] is a commandery vital to me, whose wealth and resources are needed to command the realm. I must therefore trouble you to remain there and secure it." Du Ji governed [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]] for sixteen years, and his administrative record was consistently judged the finest in the realm.

orig.zht: 文帝即王位，賜爵[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]。[[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]為[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。及踐阼，進封豐樂[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。邑百戶，[[守|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-interim]][[司隷校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]。帝征吳，以畿為[[尚書僕射|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，統留事。其後帝幸[[許昌|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]]，畿復居守。受詔作御樓船，於陶河試船，遇風沒。帝為之流涕。
orig.zhs: 文帝即王位，赐爵[[关内侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]。[[征|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]为[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。及践阼，进封丰乐[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。邑百户，[[守|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-interim]][[司隷校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]。帝征吴，以畿为[[尚书仆射|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，统留事。其后帝幸[[许昌|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]]，畿复居守。受诏作御楼船，于陶河试船，遇风没。帝为之流涕。

vern.zht: 文帝即王位，賜給杜畿[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]爵位，徵召他擔任[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。等到文帝登基，杜畿進封爲豐樂[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，食邑一百戶，代理[[司隸校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]。文帝征討吳國，任命杜畿爲[[尚書僕射|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，統管留守事務。其後文帝駕臨[[許昌|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]]，杜畿再次留守。杜畿受詔製造御用樓船，在陶河試船，遇風沉沒而死。文帝爲他流淚。
vern.zhs: 文帝即王位，赐给杜畿[[关内侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]爵位，征召他担任[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。等到文帝登基，杜畿进封为丰乐[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，食邑一百户，代理[[司隶校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]。文帝征讨吴国，任命杜畿为[[尚书仆射|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，统管留守事务。其后文帝驾临[[许昌|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]]，杜畿再次留守。杜畿受诏制造御用楼船，在陶河试船，遇风沉没而死。文帝为他流泪。

passages.en: When Cao Pi (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) assumed the kingship, he granted Du Ji the title [[Marquis Within the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]] and [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] him to serve in the [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]. On ascending the throne, Cao Pi promoted him to [[Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]] of Fengle, with a fief of one hundred households, and appointed him [[interim|/translations/officials#glossary-interim]] [[Colonel of the Capital|/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]. When the emperor campaigned against Wu, he made Du Ji [[Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]] and placed him in charge of affairs at the capital. Later, when the emperor visited [[Xuchang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.029893&lng=114.02211887&name=Xuchang]], Ji again remained behind to govern. Du Ji was ordered to build a tower ship for the emperor, but while testing it on the Tao River, he encountered a gale and drowned. The emperor wept for him.

annotations.zht: 《魏略》曰：初畿在郡，被書錄寡婦。是時他郡或有已自相配嫁，依書皆錄奪，啼哭道路。畿但取寡者，故所送少；及趙儼代畿而所送多。文帝問畿：「前君所送何少，今何多也？」畿對曰：「臣前所錄皆亡者妻，今儼送生人婦也。」帝及左右顧而失色。
annotations.zhs: 《魏略》曰：初畿在郡，被书录寡妇。是时他郡或有已自相配嫁，依书皆录夺，啼哭道路。畿但取寡者，故所送少；及赵俨代畿而所送多。文帝问畿：「前君所送何少，今何多也？」畿对曰：「臣前所录皆亡者妻，今俨送生人妇也。」帝及左右顾而失色。

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：當初，杜畿在河東郡時，接到文書要登記寡婦，當時其他郡有的已經自行將寡婦許配他人了。那些已經改嫁的，依照文書都被強行奪回，在路上啼哭不止。杜畿只選取真正的寡婦，所以送去的人很少。等到趙儼接替畿後，送去的寡婦就多了。文帝問杜畿：“之前您送的寡婦爲什麼那麼少，現在爲什麼這麼多呢？”杜畿回答說：“我以前所登記的都是死去丈夫的妻子，現在趙儼送來的是活人的妻子。”文帝和左右的人面面相覷，大驚失色。

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: When Du Ji was serving in the commandery, he received an order requiring widows to be registered. In other commanderies, some of these women had already remarried, yet by carrying out the order they were all registered and taken away from their husbands, their lamentations filling the roads. Du Ji selected only those who remained widowed, and so sent few. When Zhao Yan succeeded him, he sent many. Cao Pi asked Du Ji, "Why did you send so few before, when so many are sent now?" Du Ji replied, "Those I registered were all wives of dead men. Those Zhao Yan sends now are wives of living men." The emperor and his attendants looked at one another and turned pale.

annotations.en: The Chronicles of the Wei records: Du Ji once encountered a boy who said to him, "The Arbiter of Fate has sent me to summon you." Du Ji pleaded earnestly with him. The boy then said, "I shall now seek someone to take your place. Take care to tell no one." As soon as he had spoken, he vanished. Twenty years had passed when Du Ji finally spoke of the encounter. He died that same day, aged sixty-two.

passages.en: An edict proclaimed: "In former times, Ming devoted himself to his office and died in the waters, while Ji tended the hundred grains and died in the mountains. The late [[Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]], Du Ji, was testing a boat at [[Mengjin|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.80924482&lng=112.79529435&name=Mengjin]] when it capsized and he drowned. Such was the height of his loyalty. I grieve deeply for him." He was posthumously appointed [[Minister Coachman|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-205]] and granted the posthumous title Marquis Dai, the Exemplary Marquis. His son Du Shu succeeded him.

source.en: Commentary on the Guoyu / Discourses of the States (Wei Zhao)

vern.zhs: 韦昭的《国语注》引用《毛诗传》的话说：冥，是契的六世孙，担任夏朝的水官，因勤于职守而死于水中。稷，是周弃，他辛勤地播种各种谷物，死在黑水之山。

annotations.en: Wei Zhao's Commentary on the Guoyu / Discourses of the States cites the Mao Commentary on the Book of Odes: "Ming was a sixth-generation descendant of Xie. He served as an official in charge of waterways under the Xia dynasty, devoted himself to his duties, and died in the water. Ji was Qi of Zhou dynasty. He laboured diligently to sow the hundred grains and died on a mountain by the Black River."

source.en: Fu Zi / The Book of Master Fu

annotations.zht: 《傅子》曰：畿與[[太僕|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-205]]李恢、[[東安|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.66325322&lng=118.53989694&name=Dong%27an]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]郭智有好。恢子豐交結英雋，以才智顯於天下。智子沖有內實而無外觀，州里弗稱也。畿為[[尚書僕射|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，二人各脩子孫禮見畿。旣退，畿歎曰：「孝懿無子；非徒無子，殆將無家。君謀為不死也，其子足繼其業。」[^1]時人皆以畿為誤。恢死後，豐為[[中書令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-020]]，父子兄弟皆誅；沖為[[代|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=133]]郡[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，卒繼父業；世乃服畿知人。

vern.zht: 《傅子》說：杜畿和[[太僕|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-205]]李恢、[[東安|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.66325322&lng=118.53989694&name=Dong%27an]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]郭智關係很好。李恢的兒子李豐，結交才德出衆的人，憑藉才智在天下聞名。郭智的兒子郭衝，有內在的才華和品德，但是外在表現不出衆，州里的人都不稱讚他。杜畿擔任[[尚書僕射|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]時，二人各自以子孫的禮節拜見杜畿。兩人離開後，杜畿嘆息說：“孝懿沒有兒子，不只是沒有兒子，恐怕連家道都要衰敗了。郭智不會後繼無人，他的兒子完全能夠繼承他的事業。”[^1]當時的人都認爲杜畿說錯了。李恢死後，李豐擔任[[中書令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-020]]，父子兄弟都被誅殺。郭衝擔任[[代|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=133]]郡[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，最終繼承了父親的事業，世人才佩服杜畿有知人之明。

annotations.en: The Fu Zi / Book of Master Fu states: Du Ji was on good terms with Li Hui, the [[Minister Coachman|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-205]], and Guo Zhi, [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Dong'an|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.66325322&lng=118.53989694&name=Dong%27an]]. Li Hui's son Feng associated with men of outstanding talent and became renowned throughout the realm for his ability and intelligence. Guo Zhi's son Chong possessed inward substance but lacked outward distinction, and won no acclaim in his province. When Du Ji was [[Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]], both young men visited him with the deference due from younger clansmen. After they had left, Du Ji sighed: "Xiaoyi (Li Hui) has no son. In fact, not only does he not have a son, his house itself may soon perish. Junmou (Guo Zhi) on the other hand will not die, for his son is worthy to carry on his legacy."[^1] People at the time all thought Du Ji was mistaken. After Li Hui's death, Li Feng became [[Director of the Palace Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-020]], but he, his father, and his brothers were all executed. Guo Chong became [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Dai|/maps/map-overall?admin=133]] and ultimately carried on his father's career. Only then did the contemporary acknowledge Du Ji's discernment of men.
